cards.title: Choosing a stream after Class 10
facts: The main streams are Science (PCM or PCB), Commerce and Humanities/Arts; vocational subjects are also available.
Many careers are open from more than one stream.
Interest and aptitude predict success better than what friends choose.
do: List subjects you enjoy and do well in
Talk to a school counsellor and people working in fields you like
Take an aptitude or interest test
dont: Don't choose only because friends did
Don't assume one stream is 'better' than others

myths.statement: Only Science students can have successful careers.
myths.truth: Commerce and Humanities lead to careers like CA, law, design, psychology, economics, journalism and more.

quiz.q: What's the best basis for choosing a stream?
quiz.explanation: Interests and aptitude, plus good advice, lead to better choices.

cards.title: Diplomas and ITI courses
facts: Polytechnic diplomas can be started after Class 10 and usually take 3 years.
Diploma holders can often join an engineering degree directly in the second year (lateral entry).
ITIs offer skill-based trade courses such as electrician, fitter and mechanic.
do: Explore polytechnic and ITI options in your state
Check lateral-entry rules for degree courses
dont: Don't see diplomas as a 'lesser' option

myths.statement: After a diploma, you can never do an engineering degree.
myths.truth: Many states allow lateral entry into the second year of a B.Tech/B.E. after a diploma.

quiz.q: After a 3-year engineering diploma, many students can join a B.Tech in…
quiz.explanation: Lateral entry lets diploma holders join the second year in many states.

cards.title: Key entrance exams
facts: JEE Main is for engineering admissions; NEET-UG is for medical (MBBS/BDS) admissions.
CUET-UG is used for admission to many central and other universities.
CLAT is for national law universities; NID and NIFT have their own design entrance tests.
Official information is published on the exam websites, e.g. nta.ac.in.
do: Check official exam websites for dates and eligibility
dont: Don't rely only on social media rumours about exams

myths.statement: CUET is only for engineering colleges.
myths.truth: CUET-UG is used for admission to many universities across arts, science and commerce programmes.

quiz.q: Which exam is used for medical (MBBS) admissions in India?
quiz.explanation: NEET-UG is the national entrance test for MBBS/BDS admissions.
